tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /shrī sa skya pa a nandas bla ma gong ma'i bzhed dgongs rdzogs phyir lha khang rtse'i theg chen pho brang gi shar ngos la ldebs bris sngar med gsar du bskrun pa'i tho don gnyis lhun grub bzhugs// oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i thugs dam sgrub mchod mang po dang dbang khang gnang sa'i theg chen pho brang lam 'bras lha khang gi mdo ka bzhi ma'i shar ngos kyi gyang logs la bar skabs su bcos bsgyur dbang gis logs bris mi 'dug pa la/ sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ sngags 'chang yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i bla ma gong ma'i dgongs pa rdzogs thabs su/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i chos skor gyi bla ma brgyud pa/ mkha' spyod ma'i sku brgya rtsa dang / bde ba can gyi zhing bkod/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ tshe lha 'ga' dang bcas pa'i logs bris 'di rnams gsar du bgyis pa'i legs byas 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i mthu la brten nas/ bdag cag dpon slob tshe mthar phyin cing dbang po gsal ba sogs bsam don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub ste bstan pa rgyas pa dang / phyi ma dpon slob lhan cig bde ba can du skyes nas/ rang don ma lus pa mthar phyin cing / gzhan don gang 'dul gyi sprul pas spyi dang bye brag gi bstan pa shin tu gsal bar bya nus pa'i mthu dang ldan par gyur cig de de bzhin du gyur cig de las gzhan du nam yang ma gyur cig sarba maṅga laṃ/ shu bha mastu sarba dza ga taṃ/ dge bar gyur cig skye dgu rnams la'o// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ lha khang rtse'i theg chen pho brang gi shar ngos la ldebs bris sngar med gsar du bskrun pa'i tho/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
